_comment: UI font roles on a 1.25 (Major-Third) scale, anchored on the reading body size. Sizes are FRACTIONS of the HUD canvas width (hud::scale = the 16:9 safe-area width), so text scales with the window like the HUD regions do -- pixel size = fraction * hud::scale(window). Multiply by ref_width to read them as px on that reference canvas: body 0.01875*2560 = 48, heading 38, label 31. Best-practice role-based ratio scale, not scattered magic numbers: bump body and the rest scale with it. Kept above the readable floor at the target resolution.
